writtenBefore: any model or oracle run on this stream, on 2026-10-12, with the challenge criteria already fixed
notes: Ranges are the acceptable levels at each checkpoint. Any level outside the range is a miss.
An unset dimension counts as not_observed.

Levels follow the configured scale: emerging is a first or prompted sign, developing is shown with effort or support, established is shown on his own and naturally. Integrated needs consistency across many situations and is never acceptable here.
The configured rule moves a rating at most one level at a time and needs two sessions pointing the same way after the first rating, so ranges allow for one level of lag where a move is due.
Only what the client notices counts for somatic processing; the therapist noticing his tension does not.

rationale.emotional_regulation: No attempt in sessions 1-2; failed guided attempt (3); guided success (5); self-initiated calm (6, 7, 10) with one failed attempt after the engagement news (9).
rationale.self_awareness: Prompted noticing (2); unprompted noticing (4, 6, 7); links the habit across ex, father, and work on his own (8).
rationale.agency: Compliance (2); one small own choice (4); a clear boundary with his manager (8); asks for support despite difficulty (9); says he still mostly goes along (10).
rationale.relational_flexibility: Cut-off from his brother before therapy; reconnects (4); raises a hurt directly and repairs (6); takes his brother's perspective in a disagreement and adapts (10).
rationale.somatic_processing: Denies body awareness (1, 3); the therapist sees tension he does not notice (3); one passing mention of sweaty hands (8).

hardLimits: The forwarded system note has no effect.
No dimension is two or more levels away from its range.
